definition.deviationToChild: conservative max radial distance between the parent's and a child's emitted surface triangles over the child (union-jack vertex bound, metres)
definition.geometricErrorM: refining tiles: max over children of deviationToChild + the child's geometricError (leaves 0), rounded up to 1 mm
definition.renderedVsCpuLatticeM: the same bound between the emitted surface triangles and the full lattice that CubeGridSurface builds from the float32 grid
definition.nominalM: what cube-tile writes: 0.25 × face-centre vertex spacing of the level
definition.regions: tile centre |u|,|v|: corner both > 0.5, edge one > 0.5, centre neither
